text: 记者今日从相关渠道了解到，一家国有超大型银行近日计划向中国国新、中国诚通两家央企新增股票回购增持贷款额度，单家新增额度或可达到1000亿元。据悉，此次新增的再贷款额度规模，或将超过2024年该政策工具设立时该行向上述主体发放的首期额度。（证券时报）
text_en: The reporter learned today from relevant channels that a mega state-owned bank recently plans to add quotas for stock buyback and increased shareholding loans to two central SOEs, China Reform Holdings and China Chengtong, with the new quota for each possibly reaching 100 billion yuan. It is understood that the scale of the newly added relending quota may exceed the initial quota the bank extended to the above entities when the policy tool was established in 2024. (Securities Times)
